questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.question: What is a space mission?

options.A: A planned programme to send spacecraft, satellites, probes or humans into space
options.B: A ground-based astronomical observation programme only
options.C: A military operation conducted entirely within the atmosphere
options.D: A commercial airline route connecting major cities
